title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode7 Mysterious Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come on in.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's Miku...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's going on here?
Miku, I thought I saw someone outside on the street just now. Did you—oh?
I see you've finally come to visit this SEKAI. I'm so glad.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: MEIKO is here too?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, this is a hologram of some kind, right?
I mean, Miku and MEIKO are supposed to be virtual singers...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's what I thought, but in that case we should be able to see through them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. It would seem we've surprised you a bit.
How about we sit down and have a bit of a chat?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good idea. Let's go inside.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't really get what's going on, but they seem to know something. Let's go with 'em!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What a wonderful cafe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm getting the feeling I've been here before as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's because this is your SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our SEKAI? Why does that sound so familiar... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Let's talk about this in your SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you the same Miku I saw before?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What exactly is this SEKAI thing you keep mentioning?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: SEKAI is a place made from feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You both have a strong desire to fulfill a dream, isn't that right? This SEKAI is being created by those feelings.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Our dreams? Mine is to organize an event that's even more amazing than RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But how does that have anything to do with this place?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I can imagine it must be difficult to believe your own feelings could create an entire world like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But you both felt it, didn't you?
The sense that you already knew this place.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, I saw a RAD WEEKEND flyer back there when they should all be gone!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So this place really is the creation of our feelings?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yep.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your world and this one are linked through a song called Untitled.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By playing it, you're able to come here, and when you press stop, you'll be returned to your own world.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Untitled? You mean the song that was on Kohane's phone? I guess we did end up here after trying to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Um... Would it be all right if I asked a question?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is this place really the result of both our feelings?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You said it was created by a strong desire to fulfill a dream, but unlike An, I'm...not really sure what my dream is...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was just wondering if maybe this place was the creation of An's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, this SEKAI belongs to the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Once all of you find your true feelings, we'll be able to change them into a song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Change feelings into a song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, and you have those feelings as well, Kohane. Oh, and—
Miku! MEIKO! You'll never believe what Rin did again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh dear. Did you and Rin get into another fight?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, because she's—huh? You have guests!
You must be Kohane and An. So you finally came to visit!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. We were just explaining about this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nice to meet you! I'm Len!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But wait. Is it just the two of you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, why?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's strange. I was sure this SEKAI was the creation of four people's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Four people? Are you saying we're not the only ones?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That must mean there are others out there who want to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wonder who they could be. I've talked about RAD WEEKEND with plenty of people who've come to the cafe before, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh! The cafe!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I left it open without anyone keeping an eye on it. I need to hurry up and get back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! You're leaving already?! Let's chat a little longer!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's enough, Len. Don't be unreasonable.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll come again, Len! Thanks for today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All we have to do is press stop on Untitled, right? Oh, it's on my phone too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh!
Th-Thank you for today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope you're able to discover your feelings soon, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When that happens, I'm sure they'll make a great song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: ...What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Aw, man. I finally get to meet them and they leave right away.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Looks like we just had bad timing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm sure they'll be back, though.
Maybe next time, they'll even bring the other two.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
I'll go say hi to the other two myself!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku, you went to see Kohane before, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You should. Let us know what they're like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure!
